plain: A former Air Force man named Robert Jacobs has told of something strange seen during a 1964 missile test filmed near Big Sur, California, launched from Vandenberg Air Force Base, but another man with very good credentials says Jacobs mixed up which test date it was. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, raises this rival account without naming the man. He sets it beside the view of the Pentagon office that now investigates UFO reports, and if the rival account holds, Jacobs's story would rest on a confused date.
